rows.en: (Okay, lunch break. What should I eat...)
rows.notes: Male player monologue, nml_nns_008. The row also has a Nanase-plate occurrence in each variant just before the closing monologue (looks like a duplicate string); the line is the player's.

rows.en:
(Oh, Nanase...
I know, I'll ask what she feels like eating.)
rows.notes: Male. "sankou ni shiyou" (use it for ideas) folded into "ask what she feels like eating".

rows.en: Hey, Nanase.

Well, I was trying to decide what to eat for lunch,
so I thought I'd get your opinion, Nanase...

Oh, really? Let me see...
Right now I... want Nyan-Nyan's maguro buns!

I see~...
Wait, that's not really doable on a lunch break...

Oh!? You're right.
Silly me, that wasn't helpful at all...

No, it's fine. I'm the one who asked out of nowhere.
But now I kind of want some maguro buns...
R-right... Sorry...

(In the end, I stopped by Nyan-Nyan
on my way home from school...)
(Okay, lunch break~ What should I eat...)

(Oh, Nanase...
I know, I'll ask what she feels like eating~)
Hey, Nanase.

Well, I was trying to decide what to eat for lunch,
so I thought I'd ask you, Nanase... or something.

Ooh, that sounds great!
Wait... that's not really doable on a lunch break...

No, it's fine. I'm the one who asked out of nowhere.
But now I kind of want some maguro buns...

(In the end, I stopped by Nyan-Nyan
on my way home from school...)
(Aah, EX-Gear training is finally over~)
Nice work, \p-kun.
rows.notes: Nanase (male variant). Also PLAYER occurrences after the last spoken line of both variants (duplicate string, as in nml_nns_005); translated as Nanase's line.

rows.en: Oh, Nanase. What's up?

Well, I could see your training out the window
during art class, so I couldn't help watching
the whole time.
rows.notes: Both variants, Nanase. "bijutsu no jikan" = art class.

rows.en: Oh, really? That's kind of embarrassing...

Not at all. It was fun just watching.
Everyone flies so beautifully~
Well, if we didn't fly nice and clean, we'd crash!
rows.notes: Male. "kirei ni tobu" (fly beautifully / cleanly) played as "nice and clean".

rows.en: Oh!? That's true. I'm sorry...
No need to apologize. Ahaha.

(So Nanase was watching the whole class, huh...
Wait, was Nanase even paying attention
in her own class?)
(Phew~, EX-Gear training is finally over~)
Nice work, \p-san.
Huh? Nanase, what's up?
Oh, really? That's a little embarrassing...

Well, if we didn't fly nice and clean,
we'd crash!
Ahaha, no need to apologize. I was joking!

(So Nanase was watching me the whole class...
Wait, did Nanase even pay attention
in her own class?)
...Uh, yeah...
rows.notes: x4: the player's reply to Nanase trailing off about Ranka, in both variants (first occurrence has no plate).

rows.en:
(That's another week done.
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, it's Nanase...
Perfect timing. Maybe I'll ask what her plans are.)
Hey, Nanase. Got a minute?

\p-kun,
what's up?
rows.notes: Nanase (male); also nml_nns_014 male. Fits both.

rows.en:
Oh, I was just wondering how you're
spending this weekend, Nanase...

This weekend? It'll be all part-time work
at Nyan-Nyan.
Huh, I see. That sounds rough...
Oh no, not at all!
If I go to Nyan-Nyan, I get to see Ranka-san.
And after work, Ranka-san and I...
rows.notes: Both variants, Nanase; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Ah!?
I'm sorry... I've been doing all the talking...
rows.notes: Both variants, Nanase. Same phrasing as frd_nns_001.

rows.en: No worries. Well, good luck at work!

(Looks like Nanase really enjoys
her part-time job too.)

(That's another week done.
What should I do this weekend~...)

(Oh, it's Nanase...
Perfect timing. I'll ask what her plans are~)
Hey, Nanase. Got a sec?

Oh, nothing much. I was just wondering how
you're spending this weekend, Nanase...
Huh, I see. That sounds rough...
No worries. Well, good luck at work, okay!

(Looks like Nanase really enjoys
her part-time job too.)
(Phew, P.E. is next...)
(Oh, today's a joint class with the girls...)

Oh, Nanase.
No, it's nothing. I was just thinking how
today's a joint class with the girls.

That's right. Though I'd rather
it were just girls...
Oh, really? Why's that?
Well...
Oh, it's about to start. Let's go!
Huh? Oh, okay...

(Was it a reason Nanase had to think
that hard about...?)
(Okay, P.E. is next.)
(Oh, today's a joint class with the boys...)

Oh, Nanase.
No, it's nothing. I was just thinking how
today's a joint class with the boys.
Huh, really? How come?
Hey, wait for me~!
(I wonder what Nanase's reason was...)
